{{Current events|year=2018|month=12|day=7|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;International relations
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] (MSF) rescue vessel [[Aquarius 2|''Aquarius'' 2]] ends migrant rescue operations in the [[Mediterranean Sea]], citing sustained attacks on search and rescue by European governments, particularly [[Italy]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46477158 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*Eleven people die, including five hostages, as armed police battle robbers who had tried to raid two banks in [[Milagres, Ceará|Milagres]], [[Ceará]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46487147 (BBC)]
*[[Special Counsel investigation (2017–present)]]
**American attorney [[Robert Mueller]] is set to reveal more details about the Special Counsel investigation as he faces court deadlines in the cases of [[Links between Trump associates and Russian officials|two men]] who worked closely with [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/court-deadlines-set-stage-for-more-russia-probe-details_us_5c0aad1ae4b0a606a9a86533 (Huffington Post)]
*Jamaican reggae artist [[Buju Banton]] (Mark Anthony Myrie) is released from a U.S. prison and deported back to [[Jamaica]], after serving 7 years of a 10-year drug charge conviction. [https://www.tampabay.com/breaking-news/reggae-star-buju-banton-convicted-in-tampa-freed-from-prison-20181207/ (''Tampa Bay Times'')]
*[[Charlottesville car attack]]
**A jury finds [[Charlottesville car attack#Perpetrator|James Alex Fields]] guilty of the murder, in the first degree, of [[Charlottesville car attack#Heather Heyer|Heather Heyer]] at a [[Unite the Right rally|2017 white nationalist rally]] in [[Charlottesville, Virginia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/charlottesville-james-alex-fields-guilty-degree-murder-181207221122049.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Huawei]] CFO [[Meng Wanzhou]] attends a bail hearing in [[Vancouver]] while she awaits extradition to the United States. She is charged by Canadian and American prosecutors with conspiracy to defraud multiple financial institutions in order to commit evasion of [[United States sanctions against Iran]] so as to conduct business with [[Iran]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-huawei/u-s-wants-huawei-cfo-to-face-charges-over-iran-sanctions-court-hears-idUSKBN1O60FY (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Political appointments by Donald Trump]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] nominates [[William P. Barr|William Barr]] to be the new [[United States Attorney General]], a position he held under [[George H. W. Bush]] from 1991 to 1993. [[Heather Nauert]], a former journalist and the incumbent [[Spokesperson for the United States Department of State]], is proposed as [[United States Ambassador to the United Nations|U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-us-canada-46487122 (BBC)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump/trump-picks-attorney-general-and-u-n-envoy-in-fresh-staff-shake-up-idUSKBN1O61YN (Reuters)]
*[[Christian Democratic Union of Germany leadership election, 2018]]
**[[Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer]] succeeds [[Angela Merkel]] as the new chairperson of the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]], one of the major [[political party|political parties]] in [[Germany]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/07/annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-elected-merkels-successor-as-christian-democrat-leader (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**Scientists from the [[University of Geneva]] announce that a previously-known [[Neptune]]-sized [[exoplanet]], [[HAT-P-11b]], has a slowly-escaping [[helium]] atmosphere. [https://www.ibtimes.com/strange-neptune-sized-exoplanet-resembling-inflated-balloon-discovered-may-hold-key-2740075 (International Business Times)] [https://phys.org/news/2018-12-helium-exoplanet-inflated-balloon.html (Phys.org)]
*[[Chinese Lunar Exploration Program]]
**The [[China National Space Administration]] successfully launches [[Chang'e 4]] from [[Xichang Satellite Launch Center]] which will attempt the first ever robotic landing on the [[far side of the Moon]] in 2019. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-46471668 (BBC)]
